name: shiftowed-monorepo
description: Shiftowed: a Fair Workweek predictability-pay calculator for hourly workers.
author: Joel Stain Lobo (https://github.com/lobojoel2003)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shiftowed/rules && npm run build -w shiftowed
scripts.test: npm run test -w @shiftowed/rules && npm run test -w shiftowed
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @shiftowed/rules && npm run test:coverage -w shiftowed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shiftowed/rules && npm run typecheck -w shiftowed
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run validate:rules && npm test
